mapper.sql: select g.log_id, g.log_type, g.action, g.provider_code, p.provider_name, g.channel_code, ifnull(nullif(c.display_name, ''), c.channel_name) as channel_name, g.out_trade_no, g.member_id, m.phone, g.request_url, g.request_body, g.response_body, g.http_status, g.success, g.error_msg, g.client_ip, g.cost_ms, g.create_time from biz_pay_gateway_log g left join biz_pay_provider p on p.provider_code = g.provider_code left join biz_pay_channel c on c.channel_code = g.channel_code left join biz_member m on m.member_id = g.member_id
mapper.insert: insert into biz_pay_gateway_log ( log_type, action, provider_code, channel_code, out_trade_no, member_id, request_url, request_body, response_body, http_status, success, error_msg, client_ip, cost_ms, create_time ) values ( #{logType}, #{action}, #{providerCode}, #{channelCode}, #{outTradeNo}, #{memberId}, #{requestUrl}, #{requestBody}, #{responseBody}, #{httpStatus}, #{success}, #{errorMsg}, #{clientIp}, #{costMs}, sysdate() )
